ITEM.PTXT: To use the ETC system, the ETC card must be set (authenticated).

With ACC or IG ON (after initial processing is complete), insert the "ETC card" into the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly. When an ETC card is inserted, the green light of the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly blinks along with a "beep" voice guidance from the vehicle speakers, and the ETC card is authenticated. When authentication of an ETC card within its expiration date is complete, "Chime, ETC card inserted" or "Chime, the ETC card expires at the end of this month. Please check the card" voice guidance is given and the green light comes on. At this time, "ETC card inserted" or "The ETC card expires at the end of this month. Please check the card" message is displayed as an interrupt. Also, when authentication of an expired ETC card is completed, the green light comes on along with the voice guidance "Bong, the ETC card has expired". At this time, the message "The ETC card has expired" is displayed on the display as an interrupt.

If authentication cannot be performed due to improper card insertion, etc., the green light does not come on, the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly continuously sounds a "beep beep, beep beep, beep beep..." notification sound, and the orange light blinks. In addition, the voice guidance "Bong, cannot read ETC card, please check the card" is given from the vehicle speakers, and the message "Cannot read ETC card, please check the card **" is displayed as an interrupt on the display. (In this case, remove the ETC card, check the insertion direction of the ETC card, and then insert the ETC card into the ETC unit again)

If initialization (setup processing) of the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly has not been performed, the green light does not illuminate and the orange light blinks together with the voice guidance "Beep beep, not set up, error 05". (In this case, remove the ETC card, register the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly, and then insert the ETC card into the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly again)
When using the ETC system, leave the ETC card inserted in the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly.
Voice guidance from the vehicle speakers and interrupt displays are not given until approximately 20 seconds or more have elapsed after ACC or IG ON.
The notification sound of the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly continues until the ETC card is removed.
** is a unified error code; one of error 02, error 03 or error 05 is announced.
Voice guidance is given even if ETC voice guidance in the ETC settings function is set to "Off".
The interrupt display is shown even if ETC interrupt display in the ETC settings function is set to "Off".

The ETC card expiration notification function at completion of ETC card authentication is a function that gives a simple notification of the card's expiration date. Always check the expiration date on the card before using the ETC on-board unit.
